title: jonquilla viridiflora
intro: Jonquilla viridiflora, commonly known as the green jonquil or Daffodil, is a type of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve mood due to its therapeutic actions, such as a natural anxiolytic and antidepressant. The bioactive constituents of Jonquilla viridiflora include alkaloids, particularly galantamine, which is responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, but further research is necessary to confirm its effectiveness for these uses.
